title: OpenDEA Assessment Gap
description: A structured comparison between a current state and an explicit reference (CR-AM-08 §7). Gap types are never conflated: target-gap (vs declared target), benchmark-gap (vs cohort reference from a BenchmarkComparison), trend-gap (vs the subject's own previous state), threshold-gap (vs a governed threshold), coverage-gap (assessed vs required scope) are different statements even when the numbers coincide. A gap is derived evidence-interpretation — it prescribes no action (CR-AM-08 §9). Cross-field consistency (reference kind ↔ gap type, difference arithmetic) is enforced by the conformance suite.

subject.description: What the gap is about — at least one governed reference.

current.description: The subject's current state on the gap axis. Numeric scores and maturity-level identifiers are both valid values — the unit disambiguates.

reference.description: The explicit reference side of the gap. `kind` must agree with the gap type (conformance-enforced): target-gap→target, benchmark-gap→cohort-*, trend-gap→previous-state, threshold-gap→threshold, coverage-gap→required-scope.

source.description: The artifact the reference value comes from — mandatory for benchmark-gap (the BenchmarkComparison) and trend-gap (the previous AssessmentResult); conformance-enforced.

difference.description: The quantified gap. Sign convention: absolute = current − reference (negative = below reference). Conformance asserts arithmetic and direction consistency when both sides are numeric.

absolute.description: current − reference, in the axis unit (or level steps for maturity levels).

relative_percent.description: Optional relative difference as a percentage of the reference value.

lineage.description: Derivation lineage: the evidence artifacts the gap is computed from, the insights that identified it (when any), and the derivation timestamp.

identified_by.description: AssessmentInsight references that identified this gap.
